values.note: Every RV site is $36 a night (a 'parking fee per sleeping facility'), the same on a Tuesday and a Saturday in November 2026 and June 2027; weekly $216. Plus a non-refundable $7.75 reservation fee per reservation. Changes or cancellations cost $15.50; inside 24 hours you also lose a night. An extra tent on an RV site is $31 a night.

note: Georgia Power lake recreation campground on Lake Oconee at 123 Lawrence Shoals Rd, Eatonton. Utility-operated (Georgia Power) -> classified private per project convention. Wooded loops; boat docks for campers, boat ramp (open year-round), swim beach (summer). Gates close 9 pm Sun-Thu, 10 pm Fri-Sat. --Claude
